thesisQuality.basis: Record backlog/bookings, profitable growth and cash generation demonstrate durable demand/value capture, with project concentration limiting exceptional treatment.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Strong bookings/backlog growth, margins, income and cash flow support lower-exceptional momentum.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Valuation is balanced rather than compelling relative to strong growth.

catalystScore.basis: Backlog, data-center award and capacity expansion are identifiable catalysts.

governancePower.basis: Profitable execution, cash generation and unlevered balance sheet support stewardship.

alignment2036.basis: Electrical distribution supports durable grid and compute infrastructure.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Shared capabilities span utility, industrial and data-center markets.

bottleneckControl.basis: Orders, backlog and capacity expansion evidence scarce engineered electrical capacity.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Multiple end markets offset project lumpiness.

substitutionResilience.basis: Custom engineered systems create replacement friction.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Liquidity and capacity investment help, while throughput dependencies remain.

pricingPower.basis: Gross margin plus record orders/backlog support strong value capture.

riskEvidence.basis: Project concentration and timing risks are offset by profitability and liquidity.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Current primary, independent and market evidence provide high coverage.
